description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover editing and reviewing the package-root AGENTS.md and the consumer template, including the budget-meter signal and the pointer-ratio contract the skill enforces. Near-misses use the skill's own named exclusion (copilot-instructions belongs to copilot-agents-optimization) plus two neighbours that touch AGENTS.md-adjacent text without the Thin-Root contract: generic telegraph condensation of a memory file (condense-memory) and editing agent docs outside AGENTS.md (agent-docs-writing). Counterexamples guard the bare word 'agents' and an unrelated README edit.

bau einen Verweis auf den neuen Contract in die AGENTS.md ein, ohne die Zeichengrenze zu reißen
